description:
The proposed works comprise the internal refurbishment and conservation-led repair of Flat 10, The Gables, a Grade II listed building. No extensions or demolition works are proposed, and there are no alterations to the external appearance of the building.

The works include the replacement of the existing kitchen and bathroom, upgrading of the electrical and plumbing installations, replacement of the heating system including the relocation of radiators, and installation of new mechanical extraction utilising existing ventilation openings.

Existing significant historic fabric will be retained wherever practicable, including the original timber windows, entrance door and fanlight, floorboards, lath and plaster ceilings, cornices, skirtings and architraves. Localised repairs will be undertaken using appropriate conservation materials and traditional techniques where required.

The proposals also include the replacement of later non-original internal doors with traditional four-panel timber doors, repair and reinstatement of historic detailing where appropriate, replacement of the later fireplace within Room 2 with a more appropriate Edwardian-style fireplace based on surviving examples within The Gables, and the replacement of secondary glazing with a sympathetic reversible system.

All works have been designed to minimise intervention to the historic fabric, reuse existing service routes and openings wherever practicable, and preserve the architectural and historic significance of the listed building. The proposals are fully detailed within the accompanying drawings, Schedule of Works and Heritage Impact Statement.
site_name: Flat 10, The Gables, Fortis Green, Hornsey, London, N10 3EA
